organization.description: Organization name shown in Newsgroups headers of locally posted articles

server_fqdn.description: Fully qualified domain name of this news server, used in NNTP banners and Path headers

domain.description: DNS domain used to qualify bare hostnames appearing in article headers

from_host.description: Hostname placed in the From header of articles posted through this server

path_host.description: Token inserted into the Path header to identify this server in the article propagation chain

complaints_email.description: E-mail address published for abuse and spam complaints; also serves as the postmaster contact

moderator_mailer.description: E-mail address template for contacting newsgroup moderators; INN replaces %s with the group name (dots converted to hyphens)

nntp_port.description: TCP port innd listens on for NNTP connections; 119 is the standard plain-text port, 563 is used for NNTPS

bind_address.description: IPv4 address innd binds to; leave empty to accept connections on all network interfaces

bind_address6.description: IPv6 address innd binds to; leave empty to accept connections on all network interfaces

spool_dir.description: Root directory of the news spool filesystem; all article storage subdirectories are created here — place on a dedicated partition for production use

log_dir.description: Directory where INN writes news.notice, news.err, and other operational log files

storage_method.description: Article storage back-end: tradSpool (one file per article in a hierarchy), CNFS (cyclic buffer, fixed size), timehash, or timecaf

enable_overview.description: Build and maintain the overview (NOV) database; required for XOVER/OVER support used by virtually all news reader clients

overview_method.description: Overview storage driver: tradindexed (one index file per group, simple), buffindexed (shared buffer pool, faster), or ovdb (Berkeley DB, scalable)

article_cutoff_days.description: Reject articles whose Date header is older than this many days; set to 0 to disable age-based rejection

max_article_size.description: Maximum accepted article size in bytes including all headers for incoming feed articles; 0 means unlimited

local_max_article_size.description: Maximum article size in bytes for articles submitted by locally connected NNTP posting clients

max_to_post.description: Maximum number of articles a single NNTP session may post before the connection is terminated

check_included_text.description: Reject followup articles where the ratio of quoted text to new text is too high; reduces content-free quote-only posts

spool_first.description: Write the article to spool before sending the 240 acknowledgement; safer against crashes but adds latency for posting clients

max_connections.description: Maximum simultaneous inbound NNTP connections accepted by innd; set to 0 for no limit

client_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before an idle reader connection is forcibly closed; 900 = 15 minutes

peer_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before an idle peer feed connection is forcibly closed; 3600 = 1 hour

reader_slave.description: Run innd in relay-only slave mode: accept only IHAVE article transfers, refuse articles posted directly by local clients

allow_newnews.description: Allow the NEWNEWS command; can generate significant bandwidth on large spools — disable on public-facing servers

allow_ihave.description: Accept article offers from authorised upstream peers via the IHAVE command; disable to prevent all inbound feeds

log_art_size.description: Include the byte size of each article in the news.notice transfer log entries

log_ip_addr.description: Record the remote IP address of every connecting NNTP client in the log

nntp_act_sync.description: Flush the activity log to disk after every N articles; 0 flushes only when a connection closes

want_trash.description: Accept articles posted to unrecognised newsgroups and file them in the junk pseudo-group rather than rejecting them outright

extra_config.description: Additional inn.conf directives not covered by the template, appended verbatim at the end of the file

key.description: inn.conf directive name exactly as it appears in inn.conf(5), e.g. innflags or hiscachesize

value.description: Directive value as it should appear in the file; manually quote string values that contain spaces

comment.description: One-line explanation of why this directive is set, placed as a comment above the directive line
